item.title: Iran's Araghchi meets Omani counterpart in Muscat
item.description:
Iran's Araghchi meets Omani counterpart in Muscat

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has met his Omani counterpart in the capital of Muscat.

"A constructive meeting today with my colleague @araghchi," Omani foreign minister Badr Albusaidi wrote in a post on X. "We reviewed the steady course of Oman–Iran relations and practical ways to deepen cooperation between our two countries."

"We also exchanged views on the latest diplomatic efforts underway to address regional challenges, and reaffirmed the importance of continued dialogue and consultation in support of de-escalation and peaceful solutions."

Mamdani to disband special NYPD unit deployed during pro-Palestinian protests
item.description:
Mamdani to disband special NYPD unit deployed during pro-Palestinian protests

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced on Monday that he will keep his campaign promise to disband the New York Police Department's Strategic Response Group (SRG) and replace it with “de-escalation groups”. 

The armour-clad SRG is made up of 500 highly trained NYPD officers who have become infamous for their “crowd control tactics” and mass arrests during protests in New York City, where they use batons, tear gas, pepper spray and other “de-escalation” weapons on disruptive protesters. 

The group came under particular scrutiny during pro-Palestine protests during the height of Israel’s genocide in Gaza and campus protests led by the student movement that started at Columbia University.

Read more: Mamdani to disband special NYPD unit deployed during pro-Palestinian protests

Israeli Knesset speaker nominee rejects Netanyahu’s bid to block Arab lawmakers from deputy posts
item.description: Matan Kahana, a candidate for speaker of Israel’s parliament the Knesset, on Monday rejected an offer of support from caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich that would have barred lawmakers from Arab parties from serving as deputy speakers, Anadolu reports. Lawmakers are set to vote Tuesday on a successor to Likud Speaker Amir Ohana. Kahana, a lawmaker from the Yashar party, is expected to win the backing of 67 members of the 120-seat parliament, including 19 Arab lawmakers. item.title: UN says nearly 4M Syrians have returned home since Assad’s fall, but needs remain acute
item.description: A UN official on Monday said nearly 4 million Syrians have returned home since the fall of the Assad regime, but warned that humanitarian needs remain acute and that political uncertainty, Israeli military activity and funding shortfalls threaten the country’s fragile transition, Anadolu reports. Briefing the UN Security Council on behalf of UN relief chief Tom Fletcher, Assistant Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs Mohamed Yahya said there were “undeniable signs of progress.” “Since December 2024, nearly 4 million Syrians have voluntarily returned to their homes,” Yahya said, adding that since the council’s October meeting, an additional 60,000 internally displaced people have returned, two-thirds of them from camps, along with 18,000 refugees. However, he cautioned that “returns do not mean humanitarian needs […]

item.title: Air defences activated in Isfahan, Iran: Report
item.description: Air defences were activated in the central Iranian city of Isfahan on Monday, Iran’s Mehr News Agency reported, Anadolu reports. The reason for the activation remained unclear. The US and Israel launched a war against Iran on Feb. 28. Tehran responded by attacking Israel and US military facilities in Arab countries. In June, Washington and Tehran signed a framework agreement and began negotiations, which later stalled over disagreements on how to ensure safe and free navigation through the Strait of Hormuz. item.title: UN says Israeli airstrike hit ‘very close’ to UN fuel convoy in Gaza
item.description: An Israeli airstrike on Sunday hit “very close” to a UN-led fuel convoy in Rafah in southern Gaza, the United Nations said, Anadolu reports. “We are concerned that strikes that targets near our staffed vehicles, especially vehicles carrying fuel, expose them to unacceptable risks,” UN deputy spokesman Farhan Haq told reporters on Monday. “Civilians, including humanitarian workers, must always be protected,” he added. Asked whether the UN had raised the subject of the incident with Israeli authorities, Haq said: “Yes, we have raised this with our interlocutors.
